cert_project_submission_dates_order.name: cert_project_submission_dates_order
cert_project_submission_dates_order.value: "cert_project"."submitted_at" IS NULL OR "cert_project"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "cert_project"."accepted_at" >= "cert_project"."submitted_at"

entity_role_validity_order.name: entity_role_validity_order
entity_role_validity_order.value: "entity_role"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "entity_role"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "entity_role"."valid_until" >= "entity_role"."valid_from"

role_binding_scope_consistent.name: role_binding_scope_consistent
role_binding_scope_consistent.value: ("role_binding"."scope_type" = 'project' AND "role_binding"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("role_binding"."scope_type" IN ('global', 'own') AND "role_binding"."scope_id" IS NULL)
